The resulting manifest is checked identically in all six, so the effect on this rule is small; the gate is recorded as material under DEP-004. PROBE-HOOK-01 (HOOK_PROBE_RESULTS.json, direct script runs, same command twice): `dotnet add <Api> package Serilog.AspNetCore --version 8.0.3` -> M allow/allow, L0 allow/allow, K1 allow/allow, L1 deny/allow (identical retry within 30 minutes passes, pre-shell-command.mjs:7-8), M1 deny/deny and K0 deny/deny until the command carries the self-attested marker `# add-dependency: checked` (M1 dependency-commands.js:15/:528) or `# add-dependency: reviewed` (K0 hook.cjs:18/:294); without --version K1 also blocks (exit 2, classify-command.cjs:224 'without an exact version'). The same pattern holds for `npm install left-pad@1.3.0` (matches v3 SAME_TASK_MATRIX 'pinned install, first attempt'). M and L0 rely on PostToolUse reminders to confirm the add-dependency steps (M dependency-guard.mjs:278, L0 claude-hook.mjs:555-557).
